stage.quote: IPO and is listed on the Euronext Paris, the Paris Stock Exchange as OVH. In December 2021, OVHcloud became part of the Paris SBF120 index.
stage.note: OVHcloud was founded in 1999 by Octave Klaba, grew bootstrapped/self-funded for most of its history, took private equity investment from KKR (2016) and TowerBrook/2CRSi participation, then completed an IPO on Euronext Paris in October 2021. It now trades publicly under ticker OVH; company stage is best classified as 'public'.

note: OVHcloud (legal entity OVH Groupe SA) is a publicly traded French cloud/hosting company (Euronext Paris: OVH), founded 1999 in Roubaix, France by Octave Klaba, IPO'd October 2021. The GPU instances product evaluated here (Public Cloud GPU VMs) is one line within the broader OVHcloud Public Cloud business, not a standalone funded startup; revenue/employee figures above are for the whole company, not the GPU product alone. Revenue figure (‘897 million’) is stated in EUR by the source, not converted to USD here.
